rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; equivalent on executable triage, ruled mechanically: the project's line and the reply's agree on every input triage ran (2591 values compared, none different or missing: 1986 on 1986 fixture cases, 500 on 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 105 on 105 partial records; policy executable-triage-v2). No agent read the source; one in 10 such disagreements is held for adjudication instead.

Ruling: model error; the interface label names the four cases "deferred compensation, a fellowship not on a Form W-2, a reservist repayment, difficulty of care payments" (i1040gi p. 95, items on line 8 income and "Don't include any repayments of qualified reservist distributions"; p590a pp. 6, 16). The reply drops the reservist repayment (moving it to special_gate) and adds ira.se_capital, which belongs to worksheet line 9 (p590a pp. 6-7, Self-employment income) and is a separate project gate (ira.se_capital_gate). Triage (pass 12f36e046fb1): 2,563/2,591 agree; all 28 differences are candidate-unknown (ira.se_capital unasked without a Schedule C, classm.ira.2), 8 on completed returns.

Ruling: model error. Triage .transcription/triage/2025/ira.json (log sha matches): 2,680/2,728 agree; 44 candidate-unknown, 4 value; completed: 16 candidate-unknown. As the landing-round ruling. The project screen is any(care_payments, deferred_comp, fellowship, reservist_repaid), as its label says ("deferred compensation, a fellowship not on a Form W-2, a reservist repayment, difficulty of care payments"). The reply drops ira.reservist_repaid (i1040gi p. 95 item 9, "Don’t include any repayments of qualified reservist distributions. You can’t deduct them") and folds in two cases the project handles on separate lines: the joint traditional-plus-Roth case of item 2 ("don’t use the IRA Deduction Worksheet in these instructions", the project's line at forms/2025/ira.yaml under item 2 reading ira.roth_total) and ira.se_capital (refused through ira.se_capital_gate on line 9). Differences are 44 candidate-unknowns (16 on completed returns: the reply reads ira.se_capital and the roth sums unasked) and 4 values, none on a completed return. The project line is right under the source.

Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/ira.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 57 partial records): 693 of 1640 comparisons agree; 947 candidate-unknown. Values agree wherever the amount is known. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The project's line 7 is person.ira_line7: the applicable amount ($7,000, or $8,000 at age 50 or older) when no one is covered or line 6 is at least $20,000 ($10,000 for a single filer or the column of a person not covered); zero on line 6's No; otherwise line 6 times 35% or 40% (joint or qualifying surviving spouse, covered column) or 70% or 80%, increased to a multiple of $10 and at least $200. The second builds the same cases from lines 1a, 1b, 2 and 6 and gives the same amount in every reachable column (its 70% test, not joint or line 1a No, and the project's, not joint type or this person not covered, part only for a qualifying surviving spouse who is not covered, whose column never has someone else covered). Zero on line 6's No, as the second's note says, is the project's person.ira_below. The project's line also requires a traditional IRA contribution (ira.any_trad), the condition for using the worksheet at all (i1040gi p. 95, Line 20, "If you made contributions to a traditional IRA for 2025, you may be able to take an IRA deduction"); without one every value line is zero on both sides. i1040gi p. 98, line 7, "Multiply lines 6a and 6b by the percentage below that applies to you. If the result isn’t a multiple of $10, increase it to the next multiple of $10".

Ruling: model error; p590a p. 6, What Is Compensation?, "Wages, salaries, tips, professional fees, bonuses, and other amounts you receive for providing personal services are compensation"; i1040gi p. 98, line 8, "Wages, salaries, tips, etc. Generally, this is the amount reported in box 1 of Form W-2". The reply takes line 1a only; household-employee wages (line 1b), tips not on a W-2 (line 1c) and Form 8919 wages (line 1g) are pay for services and compensation, and leaving them out refused a lawful contribution (BUG-1156, fixture ira.household_wages_comp). 'Generally' marks box 1 as the usual source, not the whole of the line. Where lines 1b, 1c and 1g are zero the two agree.

Ruling: binding reading; project retained. The project floors each person's self-employment earned income at zero and adds the two (person.ira_se); the second floors the couple's total as printed (i1040gi p. 98, line 9, "If zero or less, enter -0-"). The reading is the owner's decision 9(c), recorded as amb.2025.ira_se_floor: p590a p. 7, Self-employment loss, "If you have a net loss from self-employment, don’t subtract the loss from your salaries or wages when figuring your total compensation". Both take the Schedule C result less Schedule 1 lines 15 and 16 (amb.2025.ira_se_earned); they differ only on a joint return with one spouse's loss and the other's profit.

Ruling: ambiguity; p590a p. 7: "Self-employment loss. If you have a net loss from self-employment, don’t subtract the loss from your salaries or wages when figuring your total compensation." The project floors each spouse's self-employment earned income at zero before adding (amb.2025.ira_se_floor, owner decision); the candidate floors the combined total, the other recorded reading. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/ira.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 57 partial records): 671 of 1640 comparisons agree; 921 candidate-unknown, 46 project-refuses, 2 value. The 2 value records are joint returns where one spouse has a Schedule C loss (generated 293: $157,316.78 against $109,209.37; generated 491), both refused for other gates. Of the 921 candidate-unknown records, 792 are returns without a Schedule C where the candidate's unconditional ira.se_capital screen asks a question whose answer is necessarily No (representation), and 129 have a Schedule C but no traditional contributions, where the source needs no such answer (model error in the candidate's screen). The 46 project-refuses records are Schedule C returns refused by cited Schedule C and plan screens (person.sc[].screened, s179.multi, person.plan_screened), scope. Project stands.
